where it appears from the adjoining words that it must be understood of Zeus as distributor or avenger of justice, "but as they utter arrogant words against the city with maddened mind, so may Zeus the distributor look upon them in anger." Schol. "the one who distributes all things."

may Zeus, who distributes all things, never set in my mind power hostile to me.
but, O father Zeus, who distributes every end, ward off the capture by enemies. Thus I have emended the corrupt reading "father, all-perfect, in every way ward off."
Similarly Zeus is called "distributor" at Sept. 485 and Justice "directing all to its end" at Ag. 781.
